// why: Type-checks src/index.d.ts by USING it, the way a consumer would. Not part of any build, and
not part of `npm test`: it needs `npx -y typescript`, and `npm test` must keep working with no
network and no installs. Run it with `npm run typecheck`; CI runs it on every push.
`paths` maps the package name onto the declaration file so consumer.ts can write the real
import specifier. That is deliberately NOT a test of the package.json exports wiring -- a
mapped path would resolve even if `exports` were wrong. The tarball install in the release
checklist is what tests the wiring; this tests the declarations.
